name: etn
description: ETN — The Endless Thought Network. Self-hosted graph-of-thoughts application.

scripts.build:shared: npm -w @etn/shared run build && npm -w @etn/markdown run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm -w @etn/server run build && npm -w @etn/client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @etn/server run typecheck && npm -w @etn/client run typecheck && npm -w @etn/shared run typecheck && npm -w @etn/markdown run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w @etn/server test && npm -w @etn/client test && npm -w @etn/markdown test
